messages:
Tom Eaton (Velaris CTO): quick kickoff — Velaris wants to run a 3-week POC for our customer-support augmentation use case. main asks: data residency (EU), DPA/BAA, SOC2, and a brief pen-test scope. also need expected cost for ~50k tokens/day.
Alex Chen: thanks Tom — noted. @Maria will own the POC tech plan, @Jamal will handle security artifacts. rough timeline: week0 config, week1 pilot, week2 evals + handoff? does that work?
Maria Lopez: yep. can you confirm the top 3 success criteria? i'll build prompts/evals around them.
Tom Eaton (Velaris CTO): 1) end-to-end response latency <250ms for 16k context prompts at 8 QPS, 2) per-response accuracy >= 88% on our 120 prompt eval set, 3) ability to keep PII in Velaris VPC (or guaranteed deletion after session).
Maria Lopez: perfect. i'll prep an eval harness and share a sample prompt set. example prompt we plan to use: ```You are a customer support assistant. Provide a one-paragraph resolution and a confidence score (0-1).```
Sophie Rivera: ops note — to meet VPC requirement we'll propose Redwood Private (VPC peering) or Dedicated with VPC egress controls. on-prem option is possible but lengthens setup to ~4-6 weeks.
Tom Eaton (Velaris CTO): prefer VPC peering if it satisfies GDPR + BAA for HIPAA-adjacent tickets. We handle EU residency.
Jamal Khan: security checklist: we can provide DPA and SOC2 Type II report. for HIPAA / BAA we need a BAA addendum — legal will draft once we confirm PII flows. for pen-test: Velaris can run blackbox tests against the POC endpoint; we require a scoping doc and a short window. Recommended scope: auth + rate limits + input sanitization; no DoS or destructive tests.
Tom Eaton (Velaris CTO): ok on that scope. can you provide encryption details? we need customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) for at-rest keys.
Alex Chen: pricing — for hosted POC we can do a 3-week evaluation at list rates; for Dedicated/Private we'll offer a short-term dev commitment discount. rough estimate for 50k tokens/day: hosted ~ $X/day (will calculate precise). if Velaris wants token caps we can set quotas.
Maria Lopez: action items: 1) i'll drop a short eval plan + prompt set by EOD; 2) @Jamal will send DPA + SOC2 link and BAA checklist; 3) @Sophie will sketch infra options (VPC peering vs Dedicated) and setup ETA; 4) @Alex will share preliminary cost calc.
Jamal Khan: DPA + SOC2 links: I'll post secure links in this thread later today. For BAA we need the customer dataflow diagram and intended retention policy.
Tom Eaton (Velaris CTO): i'll share the dataflow diagram and retention policy by tomorrow morning. also can we get a simple SLA for the POC window (uptime/backstop)?
Sophie Rivera: for POC we commit to 99% uptime for the dev window; full SLA is in enterprise contract. will note fallback model: automatic degrade to smaller model variant if capacity constrained.
Alex Chen: timeline recap: week0 (config & infra + legal docs), week1 (pilot with live traffic + eval collection), week2 (run automated evals, gap fixes, decision). target decision meeting end of week3.
Tom Eaton (Velaris CTO): sounds good. one last ask — can you include a sample prompt evaluation report format so our stakeholders can review results?
Maria Lopez: yes — i'll attach a sample CSV with columns: prompt_id, expected_answer, model_answer, f1_score, latency_ms, confidence. will share with the eval harness.
sec-bot: Policy reminder — do not post SOC2 report or BAA attachments in public channels. use secure share or private link. :lock:
Jamal Khan: noted. i'll send links via the secure file share and post a confirmation here when done.
Tom Eaton (Velaris CTO): thanks all — i appreciate quick coordinated response. i'll wait for docs + eval plan.
Alex Chen: thanks Tom — we'll follow up once docs are uploaded. :thumbsup:
